the degradation of Alzheimer amyloid ß-protein in brain.

the major soluble degrading enzyme in the human brain is insulin-degrading enzyme at pH 7, but at pH 4–7 the major enzyme is an aspartyl proteinase.

the main degrading enzyme in the soluble fraction is insulin-degrading enzyme, while the synaptic membrane fraction has a metal dependent degrading activity that is not an endopeptidase.
